build_altup_module: build a Gemma3nAltUp module with model_dim, num_inputs, and router_norm for sparse transformer computation
run_forward_predict: run the forward predict step on 4D hidden states tensor to get predictions with residual connection
correct_predictions: correct predictions using the activated output tensor and correction coefficients in Gemma3nAltUp
compute_router_modalities: compute routing modalities from input tensor using router normalization and modality router linear layer
scale_corrected_output: scale the corrected output tensor using the learnable correct_output_scale parameter
